title: D
overview:
A full moon rises over L.A. National Hospital.
D... the Daughter.
Inside - the father, a doctor gone mad...
D... Darkness.
but why? Outside - the daughter...
D... Destiny.
the innocent, the seeker.
D... Despair.
You are about to enter the darkness forever!
D... Delirium.
With stunning computer-rendered 3-D graphics, D's descent into
D... Death.
the dark pit of your soul is a tour-de-force
D... Damnation.
of terrifying secrets and challenges.

Laura Harris learns that her father, the director of a Los Angeles hospital, has killed people inside and shut himself in. When she goes in to find out why, the hospital turns into a dark, medieval castle, and she must search its halls to reach him.

This interactive horror adventure unfolds in computer-rendered full-motion video. Guide Laura through the castle, examine items and choose which way to go as you solve its puzzles and uncover the truth. There is no saving or pausing - you have two real hours to reach the end, and what you do decides how the story finishes.

- Spread across 2 discs
- Multiple endings
